back_translation: Then he brought me back to the gate that faces east,
and behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with His glory.
The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when He came to destroy the city, and like the vision I saw by the River Kebar. So I fell facedown to the ground.
And the glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east.
Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and behold, the glory of the LORD filled the temple.
While the man was still standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple.

He said to me, 'Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will no longer defile My holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their adultery and by the corpses of their kings at their high places.

When they set their threshold beside My threshold and their doorposts beside My doorposts, with only a wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed; so I consumed them in My anger.
Now let them remove their adultery and the corpses of their kings far from Me, and I will dwell among them forever.
As for you, son of man, describe this temple to the house of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure its plan.

And if they are ashamed of all they have done, then make known to them the design of the temple—its structure, its exits and entrances, all its forms, all its statutes, all its designs, and all its laws. Write it down before them, so they may keep all its design and all its statutes and carry them out.
This is the law of the temple: all its surrounding territory on the top of the mountain shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the temple.

These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits (a cubit and a handbreadth): the gutter at its base was a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around its edge. And this is the height of the altar:
from the gutter on the ground to the lower ledge was two cubits, and the ledge was one cubit wide; from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge was four cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide.
The altar hearth was four cubits high, and four horns projected upward from the hearth.
The altar hearth was square at its four corners, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.
The ledge was fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, square at its four corners, with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around; and the steps of the altar faced east.'
He said to me, 'Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is built, to offer burnt offerings on it and to sprinkle blood on it:
You shall give a young bull as a sin offering to the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who draw near to Me to minister to Me, declares the Lord GOD.
You shall take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the ledge, and on the rim all around; so you shall cleanse the altar and make atonement for it.
Then you shall take the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the appointed place in the temple area, outside the sanctuary.
On the second day you shall present an unblemished male goat as a sin offering, and the altar shall be cleansed as it was cleansed with the bull.
When you have finished cleansing it, you shall present an unblemished young bull and an unblemished ram from the flock.
You shall present them before the LORD, and the priests shall sprinkle salt on them and offer them as a burnt offering to the LORD.
For seven days you shall provide a male goat daily as a sin offering; you shall also provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both unblemished.
For seven days the priests shall make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; thus they shall consecrate it.
When these days are completed, then from the eighth day onward the priests shall offer your burnt offerings and your peace offerings on the altar, and I will accept you, declares the Lord GOD.'
